producer_report.summary: Failed checks in the introspection input now list their failed_tests names. Their excerpt comes from the cargo `failures:` section, or from the text before the CI post-job cleanup lines, and falls back to the old clipped tail when neither is present. Two new tests cover this, and CHANGELOG.md has an entry. I made no code change in this send-back. The one failing target, athena-cli --test retry, passed 28 of 28 on rerun. I did not rerun the full workspace test suite, fmt or clippy.

checks_run.note: 28 passed on rerun; earlier failure not reproduced (my change touches only introspect.rs, which retry does not read; likely timing flake)

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs builds a failed check whose output_tail has a cargo `failures:` section with a panic line, then CI cleanup lines (post-job cleanup and a Node.js 20 warning), and whose failed_tests is non-empty. It asserts the rendered input names each failed test and its panic line and contains no cleanup lines. Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test --locked -p athena-core introspect: a_failed_check_names_its_failed_tests_and_panic_without_cleanup_lines ok (38 passed).

criteria_check.criterion: A new unit test shows a failed check with empty failed_tests and plain output still renders its tail, clipped to TAIL_CAP. Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`.

The failed-check loop in introspect.rs no longer passes the raw output_tail to clip_tail alone. It prints the failed_tests names and builds the excerpt from the `failures:` section, or from the text before the cleanup lines. A diff line shows this.
criteria_check.evidence: Implemented in the earlier turn in introspect.rs (git status shows it modified); the new tests exercise it and pass.

criteria_check.criterion: The existing introspect tests pass, including the one at ~3042 that checks the tail is clipped to TAIL_CAP. Run `cargo test`.
criteria_check.evidence: All 38 introspect-filter tests pass, including existing a_failed_check_is_listed_apart_and_is_not_an_unmet_criterion. The retry test target that failed in Athena's run passes on rerun (28 passed).

criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks. The only reported failure was the athena-cli retry test target, which passes on rerun.

open_issues: athena-cli --test retry failed once in Athena's full run. It passed 28/28 on my rerun, and I made no code change in this send-back. I suspect a timing flake, but I did not confirm it.
learnings: The Bash hook rejects head, tail and grep for producers, so the output of cargo commands has to be read whole.
